column1: # 16MB flash layout WITH an esp-sr model partition — for voice+transport
# combos on 16MB boards. OTA slots 4.5MB each; `model` sized from measured
# SLOTS WERE 3.5MB AND THE TABLE LEFT 5.4MB OF THE PART UNUSED. Everything
# ended at 0xA90000 on a 0x1000000 device — so a voice+Matter build could
# overflow its OTA slot while a third of the flash sat empty. Measured: audio +
# matter on the ESP32-S31 links to 0x3cdef0 (3.80 MB)
# by 319 KB and now fits with 0.7 MB to spare. The S31 is what exposed it — its
# Matter is ~29% larger than the C3's — but the waste was there for every 16MB

column2: leaving ~3.4MB unallocated on purpose: room for the

column1: # model partition to grow when a second language or a larger MultiNet lands
# without moving every offset above it again.
